overview: You copied the messenger's entrance again and left the half-line blank after The king your father. Under it, not inside it, you wrote a twelvemonth and a day. You did not write the last line of the comedy. You did not write a song. The act is not finished.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Copied the entrance, wrote the year, and did not close the act.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Wrote a twelvemonth and a day under the entrance

summary: Wrote a twelvemonth and a day under the entrance
